chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibn Udhaynah, from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, and Al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik and Bukayr, said: We heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would pray voluntary prayers equal to twice the obligatory ones, and he would fast voluntary fasts equal to twice the obligatory ones.
ai.seo_question: How did the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) balance obligatory and voluntary prayers and fasting?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi underscores the Prophet’s (SAWW) exemplary dedication to supererogatory acts, establishing a normative model for Shia jurisprudence regarding the volume of nafl worship. By performing voluntary prayers and fasts double the obligatory count, he illustrated the spiritual elevation achievable through consistent extra devotion, a practice highly emphasized in Shia scholarly tradition as a means of drawing closer to Allah.
